scripts.assets: cd .. && uv run --with fonttools --with brotli python service/scripts/assets.py
scripts.play: cd .. && uv run python crimson-core/client/build.py --target web --package && rm -rf service/public/play && cp -R crimson-core/build/dist/web service/public/play
scripts.deploy: npm run assets && npm run play && vite build && wrangler deploy
